observations: Photo 0: a black three-tier games console on a shelf, with cables plugged in at the back; 'SONY' is printed on the front edge and a 'PS4' logo on the top right.
The three stacked slab chassis is the PS4 Pro shape, not the Slim or the original.
Two red DualShock 4 Wireless Controllers sit on top, still sealed in retail boxes marked 'DUALSHOCK 4' and 'PS4'.
Small pieces of tape or stickers on the console's left edge and front.
The console is not shown switched on; no screen, no system information, no serial label, no games and no receipt in shot.
Watermark reads 'POSTED ON JIJI GAME ARENAOFFICAL', a dealer handle; the photo may be stock rather than this unit.

read_from: photo 0 'PS4' logo on the console top

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the PS4 Pro three-tier chassis with SONY and PS4 marks; UK origin is not shown.
Photo 0 shows only the front and top edges at a distance; tape marks on the casing.
Photo 0 shows two DualShock 4 controllers in boxes.
Boxes look like Sony retail packaging, but sealed boxes can be copies; no controller serial shown.
No photo of the casing screws or warranty seal; tape on the casing is unexplained.
Needs extended play; a running clip is the best remote substitute.
Console not shown powered on; priced as not working.
